description: Read a whole sequence as one definition document. By default it is the readable format: trigger on top (e.g. { event: user.signed_up }), then steps in run order, each with a key and one kind: email ({ subject, previewText, html | blocks }), wait ("1d 12h"), branch (if/else: a list of { id, label, if: condition, steps } plus else: steps; paths rejoin at the next step), split (random: { percent, steps }), continueIf (condition), tag, untag, end, or type + config for anything else. Conditions: { tag }, { notTag }, { list }, { segment }, { event }, { field, equals | contains | greaterThan | lessThan }, { clickedLink }, { hasPhone }, { smsSubscribed }, { hasPushDevice }. The end is implicit. Sequences the readable format cannot describe exactly come back in the explicit form (steps plus connections), as does format: raw. Either document pushes back unchanged with push_sequence_definition. Pass key, or sequenceId for a sequence without a key (its steps get readable generated keys). Webhook header values come back as [REDACTED]; managedBy is left out so a push never re-locks a sequence.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

format.description: readable (default): nested steps, shorthands, implicit end. raw: every step plus a connections list.

key.description: Your own key for the sequence: 1-128 characters of letters, digits, '_', '-' or '.', starting with a letter or digit. Use this or sequenceId.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID, for a sequence that has no key yet. Use this or key.

name: get_sequence_definition

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sequence_definition` MCP tool.

definition.description: The sequence definition: key, id, name, description, managedBy, status, settings, steps and connections.

format.description: readable or raw: which form definition is in.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
